facts.text: New Milford was formed from part of New Milford Township in December 1859.
The Old Mill Village Museum, founded over 50 years ago, preserves the area's rich heritage in the Endless Mountains.
Old Mill Village hosts a yearly ice‑cream social on June 6 at OMV Church Midtown Park, serving cones and root‑beer floats.
The museum’s mission is to collect, preserve, protect, exhibit, educate and interpret the history of Northeastern Pennsylvania and the Endless Mountains Heritage Region.
New Milford’s coordinates are 41°52′35″N 75°43′35″W, placing it in the scenic Endless Mountains of Pennsylvania.
Old Mill Village’s stone fundraiser lets visitors inscribe a 10" x 10" paving stone that will become part of the new sidewalk in front of the gallery.
